d: The Houthis of Yemen have carried out more attacks on Saudi Arabia. The Houthis claim they shot down a Saudi Eurofighter Typhoon. Meanwhile, a missile was also intercepted over the Holy City of Medina. The Houthis continue to gain more territory in Yemen. So what is fueling the Houthi offensive? The Rebel group is known for chewing on Khat, a plan that is grown in the Horn of Africa and the Arabian Peninsula.
